mechanism: Both drugs can cause CNS depression and additive sedation; cyclobenzaprine is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes while primaquine may have minor interactions through CYP3A4, and both may contribute to QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for increased sedation and CNS effects; use caution with concurrent administration and counsel patients to avoid driving or hazardous activities; monitor ECG if QT prolongation risk is present.
